name: Gizeld
source:
“I have no intention of becoming overly familiar. In the end, the Holy Maiden is nothing more than a vessel.”

Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Grandol.
Honest and steadfast, he devotes himself wholly to the welfare of his people. Yet he has no interest in romance, and treats the heroine—his future bride—with cold indifference.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]
